_comment: Racers. 'priority' decides who gets read when several are ready: when the first token arrives from anyone, the race waits up to 'grace_ms' for higher-priority racers; the highest-priority racer that has started by then wins. Local always races, so no Wi-Fi still lands a rebuttal.
